Jimmy Kimmel called out President Donald Trump for an overly warm moment he shared with Chinese President Xi Jinping after landing in China on Wednesday.

“He got a rare personal greeting on the tarmac from President Xi,” Kimmel said. “You know, President Xi doesn’t usually do that sort of thing, but I guess he wanted to see what a $400 million bribe from Qatar looks like up close.”

That’s a reference to Trump’s new Air Force One aircraft, which was a “gift” from Qatar worth $400 million. The president said he intends to keep it for his library after leaving office.

But one moment stood out to Kimmel as he rolled a clip of Trump stepping off the aircraft and greeting Xi with a warm embrace.

“Funny, Trump spent the last 10 years calling Democrats communists,” Kimmel said. “He gets off the plane, gives a big wet kiss to an actual communist, a real one.”

Trump also met with Russian President Vladimir Putin, and Kimmel showed an image of Trump, Xi and Putin together in China.

“There you see Trump reunited with the leader of the country that makes his merch – and the leader of the country that made him president,” Kimmel cracked.
